reuse.why: It routes the rule through the existing shouldSkipBulkBudget, but ignores the tree's notes table (notes keyed by entity id, used by notes-get/notes-save) and invents notes columns on category_groups and categories instead.

duplication.why: The #fixed test is written once, but the four average/last-month queries keep their SQL hidden/goal_def filters while also calling shouldSkipBulkBudget, so those rules are now decided twice there, and the group_hidden/group_notes join is repeated in six queries.

placement.why: Putting the skip rule in shouldSkipBulkBudget is right, but group notes are stored in new schema columns rather than the existing notes table, and an old historical migration is rewritten.

scope.why: Rewrites an old shipped migration, adds an unused categories.notes column and AQL field, and touches DB types beyond what the rule requires.

maintainability.why: A second, parallel notes storage that the notes UI never writes, plus an edited historical migration, would confuse maintainers despite the rule itself being centralised.

bypasses_abstraction.where: migrations/1790000000000_add_category_group_notes.sql and actions.ts read g.notes from a new column instead of the existing notes table (server/notes/app.ts, schema 'notes').

disguised_duplication.where: The new rule is added once in shouldSkipBulkBudget; the remaining redundancy (SQL filters plus the helper call) is plain repetition, not reshaped copies.

one_place.where: The #fixed group-notes test is added to shouldSkipBulkBudget in budget/actions.ts, which copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the 3/6/12-month averages all call.
